title: Youth celebration for President Paul Biya in Ebolowa
reason: Search-rendered Cameroon Tribune account describes a gathering of several hundred young people in a town hall to celebrate the sitting president and praise his record; it is pro-government support and not a demand directed against the state.
notes: Attendance is described only as several hundred and concerns the ceremony in one venue. Retained as a relevant but excluded lead; body was not opened.

title: CAWOF minimum-wage protest strike initiated 13 February
reason: The body report describes a labor work stoppage and says it was poorly followed in Yaounde; no public demonstration, march, assembly, or attendance threshold is reported. A strike call or realized work stoppage does not by itself establish the required public gathering.
notes: The state-set minimum wage is the reported policy target. Evidence is insufficient for a protest event; no claim that a separate assembly did not occur.
open_questions: Did any separate street/public assembly accompany the CAWOF work stoppage? The opened report does not establish one; a dated contemporary source would be needed.

title: OTS/OTA/SECA secondary-teacher strike call for 6–10 February
reason: A search-rendered copy of a union communiqué announces a planned work stoppage over teacher salaries and conditions; it does not establish execution, a public assembly, or attendance.
notes: Call is a relevant lead only. Search source is user-uploaded Scribd copy, not an independently authenticated original communiqué.
open_questions: Did the announced strike occur, and did it include any public gathering of 50 or more participants?
